en.hero_title: The Leading Mixed-Use Developer in Egypt.
en.hero_text: Marakez builds mixed-use communities across Egypt — where the mall, the offices and the open space are part of the plan, not a promise for a later phase.

sections.title: Coast, garden district, and city.
sections.lead: Three residential communities, each solving a different problem: a summer place on the north coast, a low-density family neighbourhood in East Cairo, or a home inside a development where the mall and the offices are a walk away.

sections.title: The developer behind Mall of Arabia.
sections.lead: Marakez built the first park inside a shopping centre in Egypt, the first residential tower outside downtown Cairo, and the first international-standard mall in a governorate city. Its portfolio spans Mall of Arabia, Mall of Tanta, Mall of Mansoura, Town Center, D5M, Aeon and Mindhaus.

sections.title: What else Marakez has built.
sections.lead: Beyond the three residential projects above, the portfolio covers malls, offices and entertainment across Egypt. I can answer questions on any of them.

sections.title: What you get from a direct line.
Tell me what you’re looking for.
sections.lead: Send your details and receive current prices, released units and this month's payment plan for Ramla. No obligation.

pillars.title: Part of Fawaz Al Hokair Group
pillars.text: Founded 1989. Over 1.5 million square metres of retail across 21 shopping malls in 11 countries.

pillars.title: Retail comes built in
pillars.text: Because Marakez develops malls first, its residential projects have shops and workspace in the plan rather than promised later.

pillars.title: International design partners
pillars.text: WATG master-planned both Ramla and Crescent Walk; PBD Architects handled the Crescent Walk architecture.

usps.title: Current availability
usps.text: What's actually released this week, not what a portal listed last month.

usps.title: The real payment plan
usps.text: Plans and offers change through the season. You get this month's terms, in writing.

usps.title: Honest comparison
usps.text: If another project fits you better than the one you asked about, I'll say so.

usps.title: No middleman
usps.text: I work at Marakez. Your enquiry reaches me, not a call centre queue.
